newsitem.title: UK: NGC Corp and Centrica agree new Accord.
newsitem.headline: NGC Corp and Centrica agree new Accord.

text.p: NGC Corporation of Houston and Centrica Plc, recently demerged from British Gas, have agreed on terms for the restructure of Accord which will allow both companies to pursue their UK business independently, NGC said in a statement on Monday.
Accord is the energy marketing and trading firm the companies jointly own.
NGC will operate Energy Store -- a multi-commodity, energy marketing unit -- in the UK through a new subsidiary NGC UK Ltd.
Accord Energy will continue its involvement in the short- term-traded gas market in the UK.

NGC will market natural gas, gas liquids and crude oil as well as services currently offered through NGC Global Liquids Inc. NGC UK will under the agreement assume control of Accord's existing crude oil business.
